purpose: New literal business labels frozen before inference; same-value columns do not establish meaning. No algorithm or vocabulary tuning on this set. Synthetic column matching only; not independent human acceptance.

protocol.limits: Unknown business vocabulary must remain a candidate/review problem. No automatic approval, grain, FX, timezone or financial rule inference.

domains.definition: Invoices, customers and payments have distinct identifiers. Invoice gross is the amount before fees; net is the amount received after fees.
columns: ID của hóa đơn bảo trì

domains.definition: A shipment identifier is different from a customer identifier. Expected shipping charges are distinct from actual paid shipping charges.
columns: Số tiền thực tế đã chi trả

domains.definition: Each receipt has a payment ID and a payer customer ID. Fees and refunds are independent signed monetary quantities.
columns: ID đợt thanh toán thực tế

domains.definition: A rental order, customer and settlement batch are different identifiers even when sample strings coincide. Gross and net are not interchangeable.
